headline: Maui County Council Meeting

meeting.summary: The council approved an East Maui water authority director, adopted a recycled water resolution, and sent a West Maui housing change to the Planning Commission.
meeting.recap: A testifier said the Water Department's fixture unit policy is a big cause of the housing shortage.[[0:14:17]] The council voted 9 to 0 to use $1.7 million in Water Fund savings for West Maui water line repairs.[[2:09:13]] The council took up the appointment of a director for the East Maui Regional Water Authority.[[2:12:03]] Members approved the appointment 9 to 0.[[2:15:25]] The council voted 9 to 0 to adopt a resolution on using more R1 recycled water.[[2:23:01]] The council took up sending a West Maui housing zoning change to the Maui Planning Commission.[[2:36:04]] The change would remove a water condition from the project's 2011 approval.[[2:44:11]] Members voted 9 to 0 on the referral.[[2:52:13]] The council voted 9 to 0 to move $350,000 in the police budget for a helicopter hoist.[[2:58:09]] The sponsor of a West Maui hospital resolution asked to hold it until the next council meeting.[[2:59:30]] Members agreed with no objections.[[3:02:22]] The bill on water fixture counts was sent to the Water and Infrastructure Committee.[[3:07:47]] A member moved to pass a wetland and native plant restoration funding bill on first reading.[[3:09:47]] Members passed it 9 to 0.[[3:13:37]] The bill on private water catchment was sent to the same committee.[[3:30:38]]
decided: The bill on how water demand is calculated was sent to the Water and Infrastructure Committee.
The private water catchment bill was sent to the Water and Infrastructure Committee.
meeting.next: The County's attorney said answers on how the change fits the water code would come by the Wednesday meeting. The hospital resolution will come back at the next council meeting.

moments.q: "We were getting 160 inches of rain a year. Now it is half of that."

issues.oneLine: The council took up the appointment of a director for the East Maui Regional Water Authority.
issues.why: The authority's board chair said its 11 members cannot do all the work and need a director.
issues.next: The water fixture count bill goes to the Water and Infrastructure Committee.
issues.brief: The $1.7 million will pay for fittings and valves for West Maui water line repairs.[[#1]] A water tank contractor said rainfall at his home fell from 160 to 80 inches a year.[[#2]] The council voted 9 to 0 for a resolution on using more R1 recycled water.[[#3]]

issues.oneLine: A council member asked to move a West Maui housing project change forward to the Planning Commission.
issues.why: The member said West Maui has only one permanent housing project ready to go, and water is the obstacle.
issues.next: A committee will discuss the change on October 30th.
issues.brief: A testifier said the project aims to build 800 rental units, half of them affordable.[[#1]] The project's land use attorney said it is also asking the LUC to remove the same condition.[[#2]] Members voted 9 to 0 on the referral.[[#3]]

issues.oneLine: A council member said single-family homes that had water meters before will get free meters back.
issues.why: The member said misinformation about water meters is causing a big problem in the community.
issues.next: Meters will be returned at no cost as damaged laterals are fixed.
issues.brief: The member said over 2,000 properties are involved and some laterals are not fixed yet.[[#1]] A testifier whose daughter lost her house in the fire zone thanked the council for the correction.[[#2]]
